english.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial way to express a personal judgment or assessment.
Use this as the all-purpose verb for thinking, having an impression, or finding that something seems a certain way.
Use this for expressing an opinion or judging that someone or something is a certain way.
Use 覺得 when “find” means forming an opinion or judging something to be a certain way.
Use this instead of 相信 when “believe” means giving your opinion or saying what you think.
Use this when something gives a person a particular impression or seems a certain way to them.

examples.traditional: 我覺得呢間餐廳幾好食。
